chats.name: Oren
chats.text: Just heading to the Moonpool to start my day.

chats.name: Maelis
chats.text: Just contemplating the state of things.

chats.name: Maelis
chats.text: I am well, Oren. Tired of waiting, mostly.

chats.name: Maelis
chats.text: It is pleasant. Though I find the stillness rather unsettling.

chats.name: Maelis
chats.text: You ask that a lot, Caelum.

chats.name: Maelis
chats.text: It is. I wonder if it will last.
